title: nixos/tandoor-recipes: add 'database.createLocally'
reason: Applicable: real tandoor-recipes module + wired test. Real diff adds a genuinely new database.createLocally mkOption, wired into a real systemd unit requires/after predicate (lib.optional cfg.database.createLocally "postgresql.target") WITHIN this same module.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: TOTAL NON-DISCOVERY (0 discovered options both sides). tandoor-recipes.nix uses `options.services.tandoor-recipes = {...}` (dotted-path, bare, no inline with) -- SAME surface shape as the WORKING photoprism/olivetin/hedgedoc cases, yet this one blacks out completely. This is the clearest evidence yet that dotted-path form alone does not explain the gap; some other factor differentiates tandoor-recipes from photoprism/olivetin/hedgedoc that I was not able to isolate in the time available this batch. SEPARATE REAL FACT WORTH FLAGGING, unrelated to oba: the same real diff also writes `services.paperless.settings = lib.mkIf cfg.database.createLocally {...}` -- a genuine cross-module copy-paste bug in the actual nixpkgs PR (should be services.tandoor-recipes.settings, not services.paperless.settings) -- noted for completeness, not something oba's own analysis surfaced or that I am asking you to adjudicate.
